readme: The three masters keep the Admin_Masters structure exactly: same fixed column names, one table per master. Only the contents change to CAM (RFQ automation).

Organisations: Centum Electronics, the CAM subject. Skill factory: the ten CAM RFQ skills in ISATVON format. Tool Factory: the 30 tools, systems, servers and APIs the CAM material names. Rules live inside Organisations.

Logical Data Model; CAM component API Parameters; Costed BOM Input Template; Scrub BOM instructions; CAM_Process_Steps; CAM RFQ automation OPEN items (17 Oct); Multilevel BOM Logic; Costed BOM Check Expert Feedback; FastMCP doc; Tools Used in CAM; Commodity Master report; Master edge cases; the CAM 4.0 skills note. Cells the material does not cover are left blank, not invented.

sheets.name: Skills
descriptions: Stable skill key, assigned automatically when the row is added; not editable
Skill name
Instruction: what the skill does, step by step
Source data: the inputs the skill reads
Automation: when the skill runs - schedule or trigger
Tech stack: the APIs, models and tools the skill runs on
Variables: the values the skill captures and passes on
Outcome: what the skill produces
Next: the skill or step that runs next
Linked Organisations (blue chips) and Tool Factory entries (grey TF chips). Rules live inside Organisations.

values:
Ingest and register: receive the RFQ package (BOM, mechanical drawings or Gerber files); scan and validate (virus scan, file type, size, hash duplicate check); build the missing-details list and send it back; create or sync the project in CRM (RFQ id, customer, project details, promise date); link the package to the CRM record.
Identify and read: identify each file as BOM, drawing or Gerber; read the content, OCR for scanned PDFs.
Normalize: map the content into the unified format, RFQ ID attached.
Review: confirm the normalized package before the hook fires.
RFQ package: BOM, mechanical drawings, Gerber files (UI upload; API and email are the other front doors).
Starts on RFQ package upload (human receive step), then automated.
Uppy upload; ClamAV virus scan; PaddleOCR; Pydantic-validated unified format; CRM sync (CRM to be named).

CRM choice and sync spec open; exact Pydantic schema for BOM/Gerber/drawing to be finalized; ingestion stays sub-skill 1.1 unless decided otherwise; hash-dedup identity tuple and two-bucket quarantine to be specced.

Review: review the verdict and the risk flags together.
